summary: Created 5 API endpoints for dynamic global filter options: /api/filters/income-options, /api/filters/card-options, /api/filters/gender-options, /api/filters/spend-quartile-options, and /api/filters/months-on-book-range. Each route parses query parameters, applies relevant global filters, and returns filter options or ranges. Supporting helpers include global_filters_parser for parameter parsing, filter_options for categorical options with counts, and range_options for numeric ranges. Updated global_filters.ts to support array-based categorical filters and min/max numeric ranges.
action_summary: Implemented complete set of global filter option endpoints with proper filter application and response formatting.
implementation_notes: Routes exclude the target filter dimension when applying global filters to compute available options. Updated GlobalFilters interface to use arrays for categorical filters and separate min/max for numeric ranges. Helpers provide reusable logic for parsing URL params and computing options.
next_steps: Test endpoints with sample queries to verify correct filtering and response shapes.
